metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Featuring the mighty Silvally as it faces off against the mysterious Ultra Beasts, the Crimson Invasion expansion ramps up the excitement with amazing new Pokemon and new strategies. And with the Elite Trainer Box, you can capture the spirit of the expansion with Silvally card sleeves, high-quality dice and condition markers, and much more. Battle bigger with the Crimson Invasion Elite Trainer Box!



The Crimson Invasion Elite Trainer Box includes:

• 8 Crimson Invasion booster packs

• 65 card sleeves featuring Silvally

• 45 Pokemon TCG Energy cards

• A player's guide to the Crimson Invasion expansion

• 6 damage-counter dice

• 1 competition-legal coin-flip die

• 2 acrylic condition markers and 1 acrylic GX marker

• A collector's box to hold everything, with 4 dividers to keep it organized

• A code card for the Pokemon Trading Card Game Online

metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Echoes of Mighty Pokémon!

Kommo-o makes a mighty noise in battle! With a thunderous crew of Fighting and Lightning types, you can tear it up with huge hits and powerful Pokémon. The Clanging Thunder theme deck is going extra-big at full volume!


Contents for each Deck:

• 1 60-card pre-constructed deck 

• Damage counters 

• 1 coin

Armed with fangs, claws, and poison, Hydreigon and friends are ready to battle! This dangerous deck calls on Darkness- and Psychic-type Pokémon with howling fury and keen instincts. Make a furious attack work for you with the Destruction Fang theme deck!


Contents for each Deck:

• 1 60-card pre-constructed deck 

• Damage counters 

• 1 coin

Deliver a Thunder Shock—with Pikachu!

Pikachu is always charged up for battle and ready to show off its electric powers! You get Pikachu as a clip-on dangler for your backpack, key ring, or lanyard, and also as a playable foil promo card. Bring a new spark to your game, and fire up your battling spirit with Pikachu!

The Pikachu Sidekick Collection includes:

A foil promo card featuring Pikachu (SM98)

An awesome dangler featuring Pikachu

3 Pokémon TCG booster packs



Cards vary by pack. Packs may vary by product.

metadata.name: CardText

A Pokémon in Disguise: Mimikyu!

Time to hide under a totally perfect disguise! No, that’s not Pikachu—it’s the Mimikyu Sidekick Collection, featuring the spooky cutie Mimikyu as a clip-on dangler for your backpack, key ring, or lanyard, and also as a playable foil promo card. Confuse opponents with copycat trickery, or just revel in the mystery of Mimikyu!

The Mimikyu Sidekick Collection includes:

A foil promo card featuring Mimikyu (SM99)

An awesome dangler featuring Mimikyu

3 Pokémon TCG booster packs

Cards vary by pack. Packs may vary by product.
